title: Three-Faced Cosmic Wanderer
description: A tall, pale woman with three faces and long braided hair stands on a cracked white stone path winding through a surreal black landscape. She holds a circular patterned orb while a small silhouetted figure stands further along the path amid red lava cracks, eye motifs, alien plants, volcanoes, floating geometric shapes, and a red planet in the starry sky.
prompt: A surreal black and white illustration with red accents depicts a tall ethereal woman with three faces and long intricate braids standing on a cracked white stone path that winds through a dark volcanic alien landscape. She holds a circular patterned orb in one hand, with a small silhouetted human figure visible further down the path. The background features erupting volcanoes, red lava flows, floating geometric polyhedrons, multiple red planets in a starry black sky, and strange eye-shaped plants growing from the ground. Highly detailed ink linework with symbolic and mystical atmosphere.
